note: Exact dependency identity of the ACSD v2 rebuild implementation.  The build uses system/toolchain packages; nothing is downloaded at build time and no floating master is referenced.  Licences are recorded as shipped by the distribution; the project does not invent a licence for the whole repository.

dependencies.name: CFITSIO
dependencies.usage: FITS image reading and writing for Normalize input and Export/HiPS output

dependencies.name: zstd
dependencies.licence: BSD 3-clause (dual GPL-2.0; the BSD terms are used here)
dependencies.usage: product block compression (raw or zstd codec)

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.usage: CLI configuration, contract driver envelopes and JSONL events

dependencies.name: Threads
dependencies.licence: GPL-3.0-with-GCC-exception (runtime library, not linked into the shipped binary)

self_implemented.name: dense linear algebra
self_implemented.reason: the numerical certificates required by EXECUTION (SVD orthogonality defect, reconstruction residual, rank classification) must be produced for every decomposition, so QR/SVD/Cholesky/symmetric eigen are implemented in src/numerics

self_implemented.name: directed rounding interval arithmetic
self_implemented.reason: the geometry enclosure contract requires outward rounding; the implementation verifies the hardware rounding mode at runtime and reports the weaker guarantee when it is unavailable

self_implemented.name: exact integer and rational arithmetic
self_implemented.reason: the primary geometry kernel clips half spaces exactly on the actual binary64 coefficients (src/model/exact.hpp)

self_implemented.name: HEALPix NESTED index and face charts
self_implemented.reason: SYSTEM requires the production HEALPix index to be implemented from the scientific formulas; no third-party HEALPix library is used

self_implemented.name: epoch propagation
self_implemented.reason: ERFA is not available in the build environment; the proper motion, parallax and perspective acceleration formulas are implemented directly and are checked against an external astropy oracle in validation/

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.usage: contract envelope, object graph and result encoding

targets.name: acsd-gui

dependencies.name: Qt 6
dependencies.source: Qt online installer archive (aqtinstall), installed outside the repository
dependencies.usage: Core, Widgets and Network only; the GUI links no scientific code

targets.note: The GUI is a separate CMake project and communicates with the scientific CLI over the documented JSON configuration, JSONL event stream and cancellation protocol.

linux.verification_python: Python 3.13.5 with numpy 2.2.4, scipy 1.15.3, astropy 7.0.1, astropy-healpix 2.0.1, healpy 1.20.1

windows.recipe: MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC 14+ with the same CRT/ABI for CFITSIO, zstd and nlohmann_json; the GUI uses MSVC with Qt 6 and never crosses the CRT boundary
windows.note: The Windows build has not been executed here; the remaining limitation is recorded in the implementation report rather than claimed as passed.
